lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized in a semi-ordered grid along the lateral flank. Centroid maxima are most distinct in the mid-body region, spaced approximately 3-5 spot-diameters apart in horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observable, passing through the centers of the high-luminance blobs, most prominent in the mid-flank area posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high-luminance upper edge, low-luminance lower shadow) runs horizontally along the upper dorsal-lateral flank, extending toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a non-uniform distribution of approximately 12-15 high-luminance blobs, primarily located in the anterior and distal regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance linear feature is visible on the posterior-ventral region of the lower caudal lobe, consistent with a structural scar. A white marking is also present on the distal tip of the second dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated low-luminance shapes are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and the lower caudal fin, consistent with the profiles of commensal organisms.
